mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM user u JOIN homework h ON u.clazz_id = h.clazz_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND u.role_id = 3

SELECT COUNT(hs.id) AS submitTotal, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM user u JOIN homework h ON u.clazz_id = h.clazz_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ),1) * 5 AS shouldTotal FROM homework_submit hs JOIN homework h ON hs.homework_id = h.id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG(hs.total_score) FROM homework_submit hs JOIN homework h ON hs.homework_id = h.id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT h.title AS homeworkName, COUNT(hs.id) AS submitNum FROM homework h LEFT JOIN homework_submit hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY h.id, h.create_time ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT h.title AS homeworkName, AVG(hs.total_score) AS avgScore FROM homework h LEFT JOIN homework_submit hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY h.id, h.create_time ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT h.title, c.clazz_name AS className, co.course_name AS subject, h.deadline, COUNT(hs.id) AS submitNum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role_id=3 AND clazz_id = h.clazz_id) AS totalStudent, AVG(hs.total_score) AS avgScore, CASE WHEN h.deadline > NOW() THEN '进行中' ELSE '已结束' END AS status FROM homework h LEFT JOIN clazz c ON h.clazz_id = c.id LEFT JOIN course co ON h.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN homework_submit hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY h.id, h.create_time ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT 5
